LanguageData.Mugirl.CQ.ResearchOriginal: It's you. I'm the fusion investment contact who visited your colony.
LanguageData.Mugirl.CQ.ResearchRepresentative: I represent the original fusion research project. Your previous contact was {0}; today I speak on behalf of the team.
LanguageData.Mugirl.CQ.ResearchDialogue: We sent the first results back and kept our promise. The corporation never invested a single silver in this project. Now they claim that even our methods of researching Mugirls are their intellectual property. Are you really here to enforce that contract?
LanguageData.Mugirl.CQ.ResearchMore: Our research relies on willing participation and open exchange. The corporation has stretched licensing claims into ownership of research itself. We signed no exclusive agreement and will not surrender our participants.\nRefusing will damage your corporate standing. But the people here will live.
LanguageData.Mugirl.CQ.AskResearch: Ask about the research and accusations
LanguageData.Mugirl.CQ.ExecuteConfirm: The researchers and guards will resist. You must actually kill or capture the designated targets before collecting the corporate reward. This decision is final.
LanguageData.Mugirl.CQ.ProtectConfirm: Refusing forfeits all corporate payment. Base goodwill change: {0}. At the current relationship, the expected change is {1} ({2} → {3}). The researchers will thank you. Attacking them later does not restore the contract. Withdraw?
LanguageData.Mugirl.CQ.ReopenDialogue: Resume the on-site conversation and decide whether to enforce the corporate contract.
LanguageData.Mugirl.CQ.CombatText: You chose to enforce the corporate contract. The researchers and guards will resist. Kill or capture the designated targets before collecting payment at the terminal.
LanguageData.Mugirl.CQ.ThanksText: “Thank you for treating us as people instead of figures to erase from a ledger. Your investment kept the research going; your decision today lets us live to continue it.”\nYou refused the corporate clearance contract, forfeiting its payment and accepting the diplomatic cost. The researchers remain friendly.
LanguageData.Mugirl.CQ.ThanksRevokedText: You attacked the researchers after promising protection. They withdraw their thanks. The corporate contract remains closed and the goodwill loss is not reversed.
LanguageData.Mugirl.CQ.NoSide: No private assignments. Client relations will be in touch.
LanguageData.Mugirl.CQ.SignConfirm: Payment on signing: {0} silver. Confirm that you have reviewed the costs, deadline and failure consequences.
LanguageData.Mugirl.CQ.NoProducts: No products in the current trade inventory meet the material, quality and durability requirements.
LanguageData.Mugirl.CQ.DeliveryFailed: Delivery could not be completed. The settlement remains available.
LanguageData.Mugirl.CQ.AbandonConfirm: Abandon this contract? Manufacturing deposits are forfeited with a goodwill penalty, and clearance assignments end. Purchased distribution inventory remains yours.
LanguageData.Mugirl.CQ.Terms: Deadline after signing: {0} days. Goodwill change on completion: {1}.
LanguageData.Mugirl.CQ.FusionTerms: Enforcement reward: {0} silver. Refusing forfeits payment and changes corporate goodwill by {1}.
